visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of linked image cards (image, title, description) where each card links to a detail page
visualCharacteristics.layout: responsive grid; image on top (4:3), text below in a shadowed card; whole card clickable

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 image; cell 2 title heading, description paragraph and link (the last link covers the card)

cells: Optional eyebrow, title heading, description, CTA link (or linked logo images for cards-logo-grid)

usage: Earn Points / Redeem Points style navigation cards, often beside default content in a split section.
reuseGuidance: Use for image-led link cards with text below. For text over the image use cards-overlay; for icon-led cards use cards-icon.
